 BlackPink made history for K-pop groups.
 BlackPink received the Okgwan Cultural Medal at the Korean Popular Culture and Arts Awards for their contributions to the development of K-pop and the Hallyu wave.
 Báo Tuổi Trẻ • 29/10/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 
 According to Hankook Ilbo , the Korean Popular Culture and Arts Award is the most prestigious award bestowed by the Korean government, aiming to elevate the social standing, encourage the creative spirit of artists, and honor contributions to the development of the cultural industry.
 This year, 10 artists received the Order of Culture, including BlackPink. All four members will be awarded the Okgwan Order of Culture on the occasion of their 10th anniversary.
 BlackPink has done something no other K-pop group has ever done.
 BlackPink received this prestigious award thanks to their contributions in bringing K-pop to a global audience by reaching number one on important international charts, including the US Billboard 200.
 In terms of music , their second studio album , Born Pink, simultaneously topped the US Billboard 200 and the UK Official Albums Chart, making BlackPink the first Asian female artist to achieve this feat. The group also had 11 songs chart on the Billboard Hot 100, the highest number for a K-pop female artist. 
 In their 10 years since debut, BlackPink has achieved many "firsts" for K-pop - Photo: X/@Mikasooyaa
 You may also like In terms of album sales, The Album became the first million-selling album by a K-pop girl group. Born Pink went on to achieve double-million-seller and triple-million-seller status as of March 2026. The mini-album Deadline sold over 1.77 million copies in its first week of release.
 On YouTube, BlackPink's official channel surpassed 100 million subscribers in February 2026, becoming the first music artist in the world to reach this milestone. Their total views currently exceed 42.6 billion.
 On Spotify, the group is recognized as the world's most-streamed girl group, with over 17.6 billion streams.
 In addition, BlackPink's first world tour attracted 470,000 attendees. Born Pink reached approximately 1.8 million viewers. The Deadline world tour took place in 16 cities with 33 performances and became the first K-pop girl group to perform at Wembley Stadium in England. 
 BlackPink recently celebrated their 10th anniversary in August - Photo: IGNV
 Besides BlackPink, the late singer Shin Hae Chul was posthumously awarded the Eungwan Cultural Medal. In 1988, he debuted as the lead vocalist of the band Muhankwedo.
 Later, he continued to pursue an experimental musical style with the band N.EX.T, helping to bring rock music closer to the Korean public. Shin Hae Chul also actively spoke out on social issues, emphasizing human rights and the free will of each individual.
 The Bogwan Cultural Order was awarded to five artists: comedian Yoo Jae Suk, singer Han Young Ae, performance producer Park Myung Sung, voice actor Park Young Nam, and jazz pianist Shin Kwan Woong. 
 You may also like "National MC" Yoo Jae Suk receives the Bogwan Cultural Medal - Photo: Naver
 South Korean Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism Chae Hwi Young said, "Those honored this year are all artists who have been with the public for a long time, thereby leading the development of Korean popular culture and arts."
 We will continue our efforts to remember, preserve, and honor the legacy and contributions they have left behind."
